name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: The category selector now lists only the parent categories Wealthfolio actually budgets, with subcategory detail moved into an optional report breakdown. Per-category emoji is a click-to-pick palette rather than a text field, and it disappears entirely in clean mode where overrides have no effect.
